name: @wizpay/checkout-sdk
description: WIZPay Checkout — embeddable payment widget and server SDK. Card fields are hosted by Basis Theory, so card data never touches your servers.

scripts.build:browser: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=WizPayCheckoutBundle --target=es2019 --minify --sourcemap --outfile=cdn/v1/checkout.js --banner:js="/* WIZPay Checkout SDK - MIT. https://github.com/wiznicheTeam/wizpay-checkout-sdk */"
scripts.build:cdn: npm run build:browser && cp public/v1/3ds-return.html cdn/v1/3ds-return.html
